desktop.notes:
• Photo Library (Cullect / Curish), read-only: "Sets from a folder" has a second source, Library album (albums shown on the wall first, Favourites always there). Focus, colour and date come from the .pnfo.
• Curish edits replace their originals; offline and discarded photos are skipped; follows Library changes.
• Library photo... (Ctrl+L): one photo from an album for one screen, cropped around its point of interest.
